name: WebOS Self-Evolving Autonomous Software Engineering & Computational Intelligence
human_description: A persistent, self-understanding, goal-driven autonomous software engineering system capable of transforming high-level human objectives into functioning computational systems under PrimeGate governance.
requirements: Transform human intent into concrete architectural models without requiring human implementation directive
Autonomous understanding, architectural cognition, requirement derivation, dependency reasoning, and gap analysis
Governed mutation execution via PrimeGate with zero silent failures or unhandled exceptions
Human-readable real-time telemetry: current action, progress steps, timing estimates, activity/heartbeat status
Continuous experience accumulation, learning from evidence, and automatic roadmap reassessment
constraints: No parallel executor, second authority layer, or ungoverned shadow runtime
Preserve strict claim != evidence verification principle
Human operates as Goal Owner rather than Implementation Director
architectural_intent: Goal-driven autonomous engineering intelligence operating above task execution, where goals define destinations, architectural cognition derives plans, PrimeGate governs mutations, and evidence refines future reasoning.
